_readme: Offline play: put the line offline=offline.json (no spaces) in ap_config.ini instead of host/slotname and copy this file
to offline.json. seed/team/player pick the save folder: saves/ap_<seed>_<team>_<player>. Use an AP
save's folder to play it offline, or anything new for a fresh town. Names max 8 characters.
Numbers match the apworld options: skip_intro 0 off, 2 train and job. gender 0 boy, 1 girl.
face 0-7. starting_shirt 0-15, 16 = game's pick. house 0-3 (top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right).
town_fruit 0 apple, 1 cherry, 2 pear, 3 peach, 4 orange. grass_shape 0 triangle, 1 square, 2 circle.
train_station 0-14, -1 = game's pick. town_day 1-31 (not 4), 0 = game's pick. Toggles: 0 off, 1 on.
loans (Bells): starting, medium, basement, large, upper. The values below are vanilla.
critter_odds (bugs, fish) 0 vanilla, 1 normalized, 2 dynamic (missing from journal or museum more likely).
bug_availability, fish_availability 0 all, 1 progressive (needs AP items: all offline).
fossil_availability 0 all, 1 season locked (Spring Mar-May, ...), 2 progressive (needs AP items: all offline).
fossil_odds 0 vanilla, 1 normalized, 2 dynamic (missing from museum more likely).
New town settings only apply when the town is made. The Settings > AP ones (every toggle from no_weeds on except
shops_always_open and turnips_never_spoil, plus critter_odds, fossil_odds) only seed the save's ap_settings.ini on its
first load: editing them here later does nothing for that save, change them in game in Settings > AP instead.
shops_always_open, turnips_never_spoil, global_storage and the rest always follow this file. No cockroaches, no fishing trash, easier
critters, hidden bug/item hints and short shop talk are game settings now (Settings > Gameplay), not in this file.
